tei:div.tei:p: 261) ༄༅/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyun gyi phrin las 'jug bder bkod pa bzhugs so/ 262) ༄༅/

gu ru pad+ma badz+ra dha ra ma hā na mo: gu ru chos dbang gi dam chos 'dus pa skor dgu'i ya rgyal bla ma sgrub pa thams cad kyi phyi mo gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyun khyer 'jug bde la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ na mo: bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro ba sgrol bar dam bca'o: bgegs bskrad ni/ hūm̐: bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang : yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin dang: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis: dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i gegs: log par 'dren pa'i bdud kyi tshogs: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro: mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang: bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rol mtshams las: su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hrī: gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni badz+ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: mchod rdzas rnams/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis brlab/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ: chos sku mi 'gyur rdo rje yi: pad+ma rgyal pos 'di 263) skad smra: dang po chos rnams dmigs med cing: smra rjod bral ba rjod pa che: blo 'das chos sku mi 'gyur ba'i: de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin bsgom: blo bral de yi ngang nyid nas: sems can kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje chen po bsgom: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can des: 'gro don dpag med byed pa la: rang rig gser gyi rdo rjer bsgom: rdo rje'i 'od las gzhal yas khang: pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba spel: 'ja' tshon bres pa lta bu'i nang: lte dbus nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: rdo rje gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu yi gtsug: rta mgo rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog:

phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug bsnams: phyag g.yon thod khrag bdud rtsi gsol: rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭāṃ bsnams: g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs bdud bzhi brdzis: nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid: g.yon na rdo rje phag mo 'khyud: cha lugs yab 'dra spyi bo'i gtsug: phag zhal mthing ga ngur sgra sgrog: gzhon tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas: 264) bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng: pad+ma ge sar snying po la: bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs su: mthing nag zhal phyag gnyis pa: gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: de yi pang g.yon rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul la: pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin chen rus rgyan cod paṇa can: phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod pas bdud rtsi'i stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril: sku mdog dkar dmar 'dzum mdangs can: skra grol gcer bu 'od ldan bsam: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi thod phreng rtsal: dkar ser dmar dang ljang gu'i mdog: las bzhi sgrub phyir mos pa bskyed: 'khor yug 'ja' yi drwa bar bsgom: phyogs mtshams rin chen zur brgyad kyi: 'dzum steng bar snang 'ja' 'od klong: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan 265)brgyad gsal: pho brang phyogs bzhir pad 'dab bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen 'bru'-i: nang khong zhing gi gdan bzhi la: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dang: rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum dang: pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum dang: las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: sku mdog rigs kyi kha dog la: 'khril sbyor rgyan dang cha lugs rnams: gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang mthun: sna tshogs pad skor phyi ma la: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin dang:

chos skyong rigs 'dus mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dngos grub ster zhing bar chad sel: glu len gar byed rol mo 'khrol: 'dod yon mchod pa sna tshogs stob: char sprin gtibs pa lta bur bsam: du ma snang yang ngang du gcig: spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: pad+ma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyi rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de nas mchod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: pad+ma thod phreng gshegs su gsol: gdung ba drag pos bdag gsol 'debs: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 266) dang bcas pa la: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa 'bul: ba ling gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa= zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa= ting 'dzin rtse gcig mchod pa= sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dam rdzas mchod pa 'di dag thams cad kun: gnyis med mnyams pa'i ngang du 'bul lags na: blang dor med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang: thim pa'i tshul gyis dgyes pa chen por rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni ma hā ba ling ta khā hi: mā hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā gha ṇa tsakra sarba pū tsa me gha khā hi khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: skye 'gag 'gyur med sku gsung thugs dang ldan: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro rnams sgrol slad du: phrin las rnam bzhis yid bzhin re ba skong: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas 'dzapra bzlas ni/ snang srid gzhal yas lha bla ma: thams cad phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor che: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: snang la rang bzhin med par gnas: bsnyen dus bla ma spyi bor bsgom// gsol 'debs tshul du 'dzab 'di bzlas/ 267) oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum 'phro 'du yi// dbang zhu dngos grub blang bar bya// sgrub dus bla ma rang gsal gdab// gsang sngags 'dus pa'i yang snying bzla/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ si d+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ gar stabs 'tsham zhing nyams rtogs skyong*// las sbyor dus su mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dmigs pa 'phro zhing snying pos bskul/ hrī ma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥ sarba sid+dhi shan+tiṃ: puṣ+ṭiṃ: pa shaṃ: mā ra ya rbad: bzlas pa'i mthar stong tshig gi mchod pas kyang mchod do/ tshogs la 'jug na/ hūm̐: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyong phyir yi ge 'phros: ram̐ ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bsregs: yam̐ yam̐ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: kham̐ kham̐ la chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: byin gyis rlabs pa'i yi ge 'phros: hūm̐ hūm̐ gis rnam par rtog pa sbyangs: a āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir brlabs: oṃ oṃ gyis 'dod yon snang srid gang: hrīḥhrīḥyis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes: de nas tshogs phud rim gsum spro/ hūm̐: bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das: sangs rgyas kun gyi 268)gyi bdag nyid che: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: gu ru dā+e wa ḍā ki ni gha ṇa tsakra khā hi: tshogs phud bar bas 'di skad bshags/ hūm̐: sngon byung dus nas da lta'i bar: ma rig bdag lus ngag sems kyis: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya ho: tha ma dgra gzugs phur pas gzir/ hūm̐: che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon pas phur bus dgra snying gzir: gnod byed pho mo rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ nṛ tri sha truṃ dgra bgegs 'byung po ma ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa:

a yam phaṭaḥ gu ru dā+e wa ḍā ki ni dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa la kha raṃ khā hi khā hi: bi ta ya bi ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas gyad khams gcig bcad la/ hoḥ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol: a la la hoḥ ces rol lo: lhag ma ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i mu ran la: gnas pa'i dbang phyug ging laṅka: lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad srungs: uts+tshi ṣ+ṭa bha ling ta khā hi: bskul pa chad brtan 269) rta bro sogs gzhan du blta'o/ de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde mchog bde spyod nam mkha'i dkyil yangs nas: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sras bcas thugs dam can: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam nyid dngos grub mchog: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyi grub pa'i dpal: bum pa bzang po dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol: gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: smon lam gdab pa ni/ e ma ho: bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa dpag med tshun chad nas: tha ma da la thug gi bar: bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis: bla ma skyes mchog yi dam lha: sangs rgyas byang sems dhāk+ki'i tshogs: sgom sgrub mchod cing bstod pa dang: bris bklags bcangs shing kun chub bgyisaḥ lta sgom la sogs dge spyad pa'i: 'bras bu dus 'dir smin gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs shing: dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun: bla ma mchog gi bzung nas 270) kyang: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: shes bya'i don la ma rmongs pa'i: bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: gang la bsam pa des 'grub pa'i: don 'grub mchog gi bkra shis shog: sku gsung thugs kyi bha ga la: phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog: zhes shis brjod ji rigs bya'o/
zhes pa'ang blo gsal skal bzang gi bzhed ngor mañju shrī dhis gter gzhung nas phyungs ba dge'o// sarba dā ka l+ya ṇaṃ bhawan+tu//
